title: Access key created for another IAM user
description: An IAM user requested a new access key for a different named user without a recorded error. This may create another route to that user's permissions.
falsepositives: An approved administrator rotating a service user's key.
recommended_action: Check the rotation approval, target user's permissions, and subsequent activity. Preserve evidence and consult the response process before changing credentials.
notes: Educational Sigma-style subset. A finding is an investigation lead.
Uses the existing ATT&CK v17 reference snapshot where mapped.
